s_40666.text_1: The output side provides experience to compatible fluid endpoints.
s_40666.text_2: It can also output experience to fluid tanks and other fluid containers.
s_40666.text_3: The output side cannot turn experience directly into items.
s_40666.text_4: You need to feed the experience into Budding Experience...
s_40666.text_5: Catalyzed mature Experience Clusters drop naturally and store far more experience than Experience Nuggets.

scene_1.text_2: The input side accepts many forms of experience.
